blockingLoop.evidence: Third reply repeats the second almost verbatim: 'look for a button with a clock icon or one labelled 'Clock' or 'Time'' despite the customer saying 'i cant tell. can you just tell me what to press'

rationale: The assistant correctly identified the power-cut clock reset as the likely cause and gave safe, no-part guidance. However, when the customer said they couldn't identify the clock button, it repeated the same generic instructions nearly word for word. It never asked for the make (Neff) or model, nor suggested a door-edge label, nor asked the customer to describe the symbols. It also wrongly suggested that '0.00' might be part of a model name, which contradicts the customer's report of a flashing display.
